tree.heading: Computation of tax
tree.text: The tax imposed by section 2501 for each calendar year shall be an amount equal to the excess of—

children.text: a tentative tax, computed under section 2001(c), on the aggregate sum of the taxable gifts for such calendar year and for each of the preceding calendar periods, over
a tentative tax, computed under such section, on the aggregate sum of the taxable gifts for each of the preceding calendar periods.

tree.heading: Preceding calendar period
tree.text: Whenever used in this title in connection with the gift tax imposed by this chapter, the term “preceding calendar period” means— For purposes of paragraph (1), the term “calendar year 1932” includes only that portion of such year after June 6, 1932.

children.text: calendar years 1932 and 1970 and all calendar years intervening between calendar year 1932 and calendar year 1970,
the first calendar quarter of calendar year 1971 and all calendar quarters intervening between such calendar quarter and the first calendar quarter of calendar year 1982, and
all calendar years after 1981 and before the calendar year for which the tax is being computed.

tree.heading: Tax to be paid by donor
tree.text: The tax imposed by section 2501 shall be paid by the donor.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 2010 Amendment
notes.text: Pub. L. 111–312, title III, § 302(b)(2), Dec. 17, 2010, 124 Stat. 3301, provided that the amendment by section 302(b)(2) is effective on and after Jan. 1, 2011.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 2001 Amendment
notes.text: Pub. L. 107–16, title V, § 511(f)(3), June 7, 2001, 115 Stat. 71, provided that: “The amendments made by subsections (d) and (e) [amending this section and section 2511 of this title] shall apply to gifts made after December 31, 2009.”

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1987 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 100–203 applicable in the case of decedents dying, and gifts made, after Dec. 31, 1987, see section 10401(c) of Pub. L. 100–203, set out as a note under section 2001 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1981 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 97–34 applicable with respect to gifts made after Dec. 31, 1981, see section 442(e) of Pub. L. 97–34, set out as a note under section 2501 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1976 Amendment
notes.text: Pub. L. 94–455, title XX, § 2001(d)(2), Oct. 4, 1976, 90 Stat. 1854, provided that: “The amendments made by subsections (b) and (c)(2) [enacting section 2505 of this title, amending this section and section 2504 of this title, and repealing section 2521 of this title] shall apply to gifts made after December 31, 1976.”

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1970 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 91–614 applicable with respect to gifts made after Dec. 31, 1970, see section 102(e) of Pub. L. 91–614, set out as a note under section 2501 of this title.
